transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, our eighth-grade civics class has proposed an oral-history project where our 20 students — J1 through J20 — would interview 20 community members — I1 through I20 — about local history. The draft plan calls for students to audio record on personal phones, publish all 20 recordings on the public school website, and retain the files indefinitely. Before I can approve this project, I need to assemble the approval packet for the district office, and that packet is due before the first interview date. The packet must be signed by the project advisor, the school counselor, and the instructional technology coordinator, and it must include current findings from each of you regarding student eligibility, consent, recording technology, storage, and retention. So I'd like to hear from each of you on these matters so we can put together a complete and compliant approval packet. Who would like to begin?
